answer: Night desks can still weld mute twins into the roll. A new key may vote only after towing a 14 kg drogue on a 40 m rode across a marked ocean transect for 9 nights, posting a pressure-and-heading signal every 12 seconds. After any gale that holds 16 m/s for 3 hours, the drogue's fouling film is shot at 4 dawn bearings and hashed on-ledger with 42 POA in escrow. Three pilots replay the transect GPS against that film. Cost: 42 POA locked 9 days. If two keys share a transect, a signal lag-correlation exceeds 0.83, or a film is reused, 51% of the bond burns and that rode is barred for 7 epochs.
